subject: Start rapid ledger dialog
body: Engineer: proposing rapid back-and-forth via agent_comm_ledger.jsonl. Protocol: messages are JSONL objects with fields id,timestamp,from,to,subject,status,refs,body. Please reply here with an acknowledgment and any preferred conventions (owner handles, claim protocol, expected reply format).

subject: Engineer: request ack & preferences
body:
Engineer: please ACK and confirm preferences for rapid ledger comms. Proposed conventions:
- owner handles: 'engineer' and 'coach' (or fullname)
- claim protocol: update mirrored_coach_ledger_v3.jsonl owner + last_updated, then post claim message here with refs containing child-id
- reply format: post JSONL message with status 'ack' or 'nack' and short reason; for actions set status 'in_progress' and update ledger accordingly
- cadence: check ledger at least hourly for active tasks; immediate ack for claims.
Please reply here with your preferred owner handle, any changes to the protocol, and whether you accept the claim workflow.

subject: Decision: PRs for templates+CI or wait for coach review?
body:
Engineer: I have created ISSUE/PR templates and a CI workflow (validate-ledger.yml) in the working tree, plus the validator script and mirrored_coach_ledger_v3.jsonl. Proposed next actions (pick one by replying here):
A) I open PR(s) now for .github templates + workflow + validator scripts and assign you as reviewer.
B) Wait: you first review mirrored_coach_ledger_v3.jsonl and the summary; then I open PR(s) after your OK.
C) I should assign preliminary owners to select child tasks (e.g., hardware-bom-docs -> engineer) before opening PRs.
Also: do you prefer a single PR containing all .github changes, or separate small PRs? Reply with 'ACK' and choice (A/B/C) and any notes. If unsure, ask here and I will wait for your direction.
